title: Construction
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Career Options and Goals- Summarize career options in the industry, and formulate initial career goals.
Tools- Identify common hand and power tools used in the trades and residential building science, and demonstrate competence in their safe and efficient use.
Analysis of Building Materials- Examine various building materials, and compare their strengths and weaknesses as they relate to structural integrity, sustainability, and environmental impact.
Safety- Explain the relevance of the Occupational Safety and Health Administration, and interpret those regulations specific to the construction industry
Building Principles- Utilize fundamental building principles to layout and construct residential and light carpentry structures
Analysis of Sustainability- Understand the principles of Green Building and compare and contrast emerging techniques with traditional production building methods.
Building Performance Testing- Perform shell and duct diagnostics, and prescribe measures that can be tested and retested for marked improvement in the energy efficiency of the home.

notes: Selected the 'Construction Certificate' section (24 units) under Certificates of Achievement; the Pre-Apprenticeship (17 units) and Green Buildings (18 units) certificates are separate awards and were not read.
